Every state `hs-run port` can report, with what it means. Run the CLI, read the `state`, do the judgment that state names, run it again — each state is re-derived from artifacts on disk, so deleting an artifact regresses the state.

## States that route nothing

Not a gap: each is fully served by the `next_action` line the envelope already carries, and needs no extra file to act on.

| state | what it means |
|---|---|
| `error` | The invocation itself was wrong — `--repo` named a path that does not exist or is not a directory. Nothing was read; fix the flag and re-run. |
| `no_workspace` | No `.port/port.yaml` under the resolved target (`--repo`, or the nearest ancestor of the current directory holding `.port/`). Nothing has been planned for this repo yet — run `/hs:port` to plan one. |
| `config_invalid` | `.port/port.yaml` exists but does not validate. The envelope's `next_action` names the first problem and `problems` lists every one found — an unknown key, a missing required field, or an attempt to turn off the one rule that can never be turned off. |
| `ledger_broken` | `.port/ledger.jsonl` holds at least one line `hs-run port next` cannot read — the envelope's `l0_findings` names each broken line and why. Append-only: fix or remove the bad line BY HAND (it is evidence), never edit it in place automatically. |
| `no_batch` | `.port/port.yaml` is valid and no batch exists under `.port/batches/` yet. Run `/hs:port` to plan the first one. |
| `open_items` | A batch has one or more open item(s) waiting on a person — `hs-code port add-module`/`judge-nodes` hit a fork it could not resolve alone. An item with no proposal yet needs one from the model (`hs-code port propose`); a proposed item needs a human `approve`/`reject` (`hs-code port approve`). The envelope's `open_items` lists every pending item's id, kind, subject, candidates and proposal. |
| `handoff_unplanned` | `handoff.json` holds item(s) nothing mechanical can settle further, and no current plan covers them. Run `/hs:port` pass 2 — it turns each item group into a plan.md phase and records `plan:` + `handoff_sha256:` in `batch.yaml`. |
| `handoff_in_cook` | `handoff.json`'s items are already covered by a recorded plan. Hand off to `/hs:cook <plan>` — each phase's own `done_when` command is its acceptance criterion. |
| `runs_broken` | A batch's own `runs.jsonl` holds at least one line `hs-run port next` cannot read — the envelope's `run_findings` names each broken line and why. Append-only: fix or remove the bad line BY HAND, never edit it in place automatically. |
| `batch_planned` | A batch is declared and nothing has run against it yet. Run the command in `next_command` — the first step of the batch's own lane (`harness/data/port-steps.yaml`, or the batch's own `steps:` pick). |
| `step_red` | A batch's step last failed. Fix what it reported (or commit what it refused on), then re-run the command `next_action` names. |
| `steps_remaining` | A batch's next step has not been run with its CURRENT command — never run, or run without `--apply`, or run before a config edit changed what it renders to. Run `next_command`. |
| `closed` | Every batch under `.port/batches/` is fully green. Nothing left for this engine to hand out. |
